name: Middlesbrough Half Marathon
course: Closed-road loop via Albert Park, Riverside Stadium and docks.
transport: Central road closures begin 06:00; very limited on-site parking
facilities: Bag drop, toilets and water at roughly 3, 6 and 9 miles
rules: Minimum age 17; check parking outside the closures.
reason: Low published climbing helps a paced half, but the three-hour closure limit and early city-centre road closures shape the decision.

name: Goodwood Running GP February
distance: 50km / marathon / 20 miles / metric marathon / half marathon / 10km / 5km
transport: Event parking in Car Park C; venue PO18 0PH
facilities: Bag drop, venue toilets and water each lap
rules: Metric marathon is 26.2km; select the correct route and pack-collection window.
reason: A circuit event that uniquely includes 50K as well as shorter races. Seven start waves and distance-specific pack collection require careful timing.

name: MBNA Chester Marathon
course: Closed-road route spanning England and Wales.
transport: Racecourse event hub; check central road closures and pack collection
facilities: Bag drop, pacers and course support
rules: Metric marathon is 26.2km; later entrants and overseas runners collect packs at Little Roodee.
reason: A cross-border road marathon with a separate metric distance. Pack posting depends on entry timing and address, so check collection before travelling.

name: Battersea Running Festival October
course: Park-lap road routes; confirm exact counts and 2027 map.
transport: Battersea Park start and finish; check the event entrance
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village
rules: Compare marathon and half cut-offs before entry; junior event also runs.
reason: A rare full marathon inside an urban park. The repeated laps and separate half start make this a different experience from a city marathon.
